title: 第9章 生死与共的爱情第10章 二狗人麻了
slug: 末世我的女人有亿点强
lines: “痴心妄想，我就是死，也绝不会让她做这种事。”
青年死死瞪着刀疤男，一字一句的说道：“为了活命，让自己心爱的女人去陪别的男人，我刘宇做不出这种混蛋事。”
“呵呵！”
刀疤男冷笑。
他转头看向女子：“你也是这麽想的吗？宁死丶宁愿出去喂丧尸，也不跟我？”
女子闻言，好似想到了被丧尸撕咬的画面，脸上露出浓浓的恐惧。
下一刻。
她却是凄然一笑：“如果是要放弃尊严，放弃底线才能苟活，这样的世道，活着又有什麽意义呢？”
“宇哥，我爱你！就算死，我们也要一起。”
女子对着青年深情一吻，然後搀扶起青年，缓步向着大堂门口走去。
刀疤男脸色阴沉不定。
他不信这对柔弱的情侣，真的敢走出酒店，外面可是有很多丧尸的。
如果两人真的宁死不屈，他也不会真的放他们走。
男的无所谓，但是这个这个女生，他一定要得到。
这麽清纯漂亮的女人，他这辈子还没有玩过呢，那双芊芊玉腿，馋得他直流口水。
这特马的都末世了，在这个酒店里，他就是王。
他想睡哪个女人，哪个女人就得乖乖爬上他的床。
刀疤脸朝黄毛使了个脸色。
黄毛意会，快步走到玻璃大门前，掏出钥匙，假装要开门放他们出去。
刘宇两人看着这一幕，脸上划过恐惧之色，步伐却依然坚定，没有一丝的迟疑。
颇有种风潇兮兮易水寒的味道！
“善恶在於心，末世只不过是扩大了这种念而已。”
林羽欣赏的看着这对小情侣的背影。
“滚回去！”
两人已经走到门口，准备共同赴死了，却被黄毛拦了下来。
刀疤男一步步走了过来，冷漠的注视着两人。
“没想到你们是真的不怕死啊！实话说了，这个女人我看上了，她就是死，也只能死在我的胯下。”
“你！你无耻！”
青年一脸愤怒，捏紧拳头就朝着刀疤男砸了过去。
可他哪里是对手，再次被刀疤男一脚踢了出去，蜷缩在地上，半天起不来。
“啪啪啪！”
突然，一道掌声突兀的响起。
林羽缓缓起身，看着刀疤男笑道：“生死与共的爱情，值得欣赏。”
content_en:
"Wishful thinking, even if I die, I will never let her do such a thing."
The young man stared at the scarred man and said word by word: "In order to survive, I let the woman I love accompany other men. I, Liu Yu, cannot do such a bastard thing."
"Haha!"
The scarred man sneered.
He turned to look at the woman: "Do you think so too? Would you rather die or go out to feed zombies than follow me?"
When the woman heard this, she seemed to think of the scene of being bitten by zombies, with a look of deep fear on her face.
The next moment.
But she smiled sadly: "If you have to give up your dignity and your bottom line to survive, what's the point of living in such a world?"
"Brother Yu, I love you! Even if we die, we will be together."
The woman kissed the young man passionately, then helped the young man up and walked slowly towards the entrance of the lobby.
The scarred man's face was gloomy and uncertain.
He didn't believe that this weak couple really dared to walk out of the hotel. There were many zombies outside.
If the two of them really would rather die than surrender, he would not really let them go.
It doesn't matter if he's a boy, but he must get this girl.
He had never played with such a pure and beautiful woman in his life, and those pair of beautiful legs made him salivate.
This guy is in the end of the world. In this hotel, he is the king.
Whichever woman he wanted to sleep with, she had to crawl into his bed.
Scarface made a look at Huangmao.
Huang Mao understood, quickly walked to the glass door, took out the key, and pretended to open the door to let them out.
Liu Yu and the two looked at this scene, with a look of fear on their faces, but their steps remained firm without any hesitation.
It has a rather windy and cold smell!
"Good and evil lie in the heart, and the end of the world is just an expansion of this idea."
Lin Yu looked at the backs of the young couple with admiration.
"Go back!"
The two of them had already reached the door, ready to die together, but were stopped by Huang Mao.
The scarred man walked over step by step and stared at the two of them indifferently.
"I didn't expect you guys to be really not afraid of death! To be honest, I have fallen in love with this woman. Even if she dies, she can only die in my crotch."
"You! You are shameless!"
With an angry look on his face, the young man clenched his fist and smashed it towards the scarred man.
But he was no match. He was kicked out by Scar Man again. He curled up on the ground and couldn't get up for a long time.
"Bah bang bang!"
Suddenly, a burst of applause sounded.
Lin Yu stood up slowly, looked at the scarred man and said with a smile, "The love of life and death is worth appreciating."
